- **Mutant:** [`92.sol`](92.sol)
- **Caught by:** [`rvLlWithdrawRevertsWhenInconsistentInput`](../../specs/LidoLend/LidoLend_reverts.spec#L109)
- **Reproduce (→ VIOLATED):** `./certora/mutations/run_mutation.sh LidoLend 92`
- **Run on clean src:** `certoraRun certora/confs/LidoLend/reverts.conf --rule rvLlWithdrawRevertsWhenInconsistentInput`

```diff
--- a/lib/lend/src/LidoLend.sol
+++ b/lib/lend/src/LidoLend.sol
@@ -250,7 +250,7 @@
     ) external returns (uint256, uint256) {
         Id id = marketParams.id();
         require(market[id].lastUpdate != 0, ErrorsLib.MARKET_NOT_CREATED);
-        require(UtilsLib.exactlyOneZero(assets, shares), ErrorsLib.INCONSISTENT_INPUT);
+        // require(UtilsLib.exactlyOneZero(assets, shares), ErrorsLib.INCONSISTENT_INPUT); // MUTATION: guard dropped
         require(receiver != address(0), ErrorsLib.ZERO_ADDRESS);
         // No need to verify that onBehalf != address(0) thanks to the following authorization check.
         require(_isSenderAuthorized(onBehalf), ErrorsLib.UNAUTHORIZED);
```
